_doc: Zones for the Koi Blossom FR size-M trial crop (x -220..-50, y 30..300 garment mm; x from CF, + = wearer's left; y from the CF neck seam), re-authored on 20 Oct 2026 after the founder ruling (the GARMENT MOCKUP governs): every window sits on a motif WHERE THE MOCKUP HAS IT (mockup crop read on a 10 mm grid). A zone is a WINDOW plus the tones that belong to it: what a region IS, never its shape; silhouettes are traced from the input pixels (mockup; the close-up only adds detail inside the upper lily, bench/registration.json mode inform). Lily zones carry a `heart` window. Zones claim pixels from the highest z down; there is NO rest zone: the navy duck between motifs is bare (run.yaml threads.bare). The mockup fish at the crop's right edge (x > -82, y 145-182) is not built: its head lies outside the crop, so the crop's evidence cannot pose it (listed in TRIAL.md).
